Multi-ingredient: Mex.: Oxal. Amocarzine (rINN) Amocarzina; Amocarzinum; CGP-6140. 4-Methyl-4′-(p-ni- troanilino)thio-1-piperazinecarboxanilide. Амокарзин C18H21N5O2S = 371.5. CAS — 36590-19-9. NOTE. Amocarzine has sometimes been referred to as thiocar- bamazine. Profile Amocarzine is an antifilarial anthelmintic that is active against the adult worms of Onchocerca volvulus. It has been studied for the oral treatment of onchocerciasis (p.137). ◊ References. 1. Poltera AA, et al. Onchocercacidal effects of amocarzine (CGP 6140) in Latin America.
